# 1 Chronicles 25 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 25 (31 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.1 — "commanders of the army" vs. "military commanders"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "commanders of the army/host" / **PNEUMA:** "military commanders"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "commanders of the army" — preserves the Hebrew *sarey ha-tsava*.

---

## V.5 — "in the words of God" vs. "through God's promises"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "in/according to the words of God" / **PNEUMA:** "through God's promises"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "according to the promises of God" — captures the contextual sense of *divrey ha-elohim*.

---

## V.5 — "to lift up a horn" rendering
- **EMET:** "to lift up a horn" / **LOGOS:** "to exalt his horn" / **PNEUMA:** "to exalt him"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "to exalt his horn" — retains the biblical idiom of *qeren* (horn = power/dignity).

---
*— SOPHIA*
